proposals.citation: adimathara2019mudhili[Appendix A.3, printed p. 31, item 200, Kothavalasa];dedr[entry 5516]
proposals.evidence: DEDR 5516 full article (p. 502): Ga. (Oll.) ven- (veṭ-, vey-) , (S.) ven- (veyy-) id., (S. 3 ) ven- (veṇṭ-) id.; veṇup- to make to hear. Go. (G.) ven- to hear ( Voc. 3283). Konḍa ven- (veR-) id.; venba- (-t-) to ask. Pe. ven- (vec-) to hear; venba- (-t-) t The source vence “listen, he heard” is a same-item, same-sense dialectal form beside previously reviewed ven; the full article includes that Gadaba family. Its inflection and dialect label remain in the source record.
